entries.descriptionOriginal: 10 players, 4 loadouts, one goal, be the first to reach 50 eliminations. This is a melee fighting game, with loudouts containing a sword, a hammer, a scythe, and a kinetic blade. Matches consist of five rounds, the player with the most eliminations will win the round, the player with the most rounds won will win the match. May or may not be updated in the future with new features.
